SRC-054:R001.text: Prove the root cause: name the canonical source that regenerates .saipen/MANIFEST.json and show why a local evidence/ declaration did not survive it.

SRC-054:R002.text: The canonical SAIPEN audit-evidence contract/generator (not a generated project MANIFEST.json) declares evidence/ as an authoritative conditional closure-evidence surface, recursive and bounded by an explicit max_files.

SRC-054:R003.text: Newly initialized projects declare evidence/, existing manifests refreshed by SAIPEN retain or add it, and later lifecycle/reconcile/status/cc/converge operations cannot silently remove it.

SRC-054:R004.text: When an authoritative SAIPEN closure record (LOG, coverage, STATE, BOARD or another closure record) references an evidence path, the exporter detects that the referenced file is absent from the archive; referenced + omitted + required_evidence_omitted=false is impossible, via explicit referenced-evidence discovery rather than directory collection alone.

SRC-054:R005.text: Deterministic regeneration regression: project with evidence proof file referenced from closure coverage/log, generate MANIFEST, run lifecycle operations that regenerate protocol metadata, regenerate again, evidence/ still declared, pack, ZIP contains the proof file, accounting complete; a pre-fix red control shows the generated contract losing evidence/ after canonical regeneration.

SRC-054:R006.text: False-complete regression: closure metadata references the proof file, the exported ZIP deliberately omits it, and accounting reports required_evidence_omitted=true or an equivalent authoritative incomplete state; evidence_files_collected == evidence_files_in_archive never implies completeness when discovery itself is incomplete.

SRC-054:R007.text: Backward compatibility: projects without .saipen/evidence/ still export normally; the directory is conditional (collected and accounted when present or referenced), never mandatory.

SRC-054:R008.text: Validation runs: focused manifest/generator tests, AUDAPACK collector/export tests, SAIPEN validator tests, lifecycle/reconcile regeneration tests.

SRC-054:R009.text: Reproduce against Problip or an equivalent fixture: evidence file exists, generated MANIFEST declares evidence/, archive contains it with source/archive hash equality, a later lifecycle command does not erase the declaration, a second archive still contains it, and required_evidence_omitted is false only when the evidence is genuinely present.

SRC-054:R010.text: Non-goals: no Problip production code change, no recreated PERF-001, no special case for the PERF-001 filename, no single generated project MANIFEST patch, no weakening of existing evidence accounting.
